component.name: Avatar
component.description: A circular user photo displayed at a fixed size. Use to represent a person in navigation bars (sm) or profile sections (lg). Accepts an image src and alt text; no letter or icon fallback is in scope.

useWhen: Representing the signed-in user in a top navigation bar (size sm)
Displaying the user's profile photo on a settings or profile page (size lg)

notFor.case: Using Avatar for non-person images (e.g. course thumbnails, brand logos)
notFor.because: Avatar's circular crop and fixed sizes are designed for portrait photos. Non-person images lose meaning in this shape.

patterns.name: nav-user-chip
patterns.description: Avatar (sm) alongside user name and a chevron icon in the nav bar user dropdown trigger.

patterns.name: profile-header
patterns.description: Avatar (lg) above a Stack of the user's display name and account email in a profile section.

useWhen.sm: 24px — compact size for nav bars and inline user references.
useWhen.md: 80px — mid-size for cards and secondary profile contexts.
useWhen.lg: 128px — profile size for settings pages and user profile headers.
